title: Chicken Adobo
reject_reason: Bone-in chicken braised in the classic soy-vinegar-garlic-bay adobo sauce is the same dinner as the live Slow Cooker Chicken Adobo Rice Bowls (identical protein and adobo/soy sauce family); the only difference is bone-in vs shredded and the omitted rice, and the catalog already carries two adobo chicken dishes.
